license: Free YouTube release used in a personal, non-commercial build (see DECISIONS.md 2026-06-30 'personal-use' entry). Not redistributed standalone; shipped file is a short processed excerpt (cut + loudnorm + Opus).
notes: Clean-source refresh 2026-07-01: cut @1200s of the source recording, stereo, 48 kHz, loudnorm I=-20 LUFS TP=-1.0. FLAC intermediate; loopify-scenes.py trims to the element's prime loopOffset and encodes Opus. Seamless-looped to 521s (prime loopOffset) for native Howler looping: 6s fade-wrap of the post-loop tail over the head so the loop point is gapless. Encoded as Opus (128k) — see DECISIONS.md 'Ship scene audio as Opus, not MP3'.

wrapPatch.why: loopify-scenes.py never mixed the wrap crossfade tail in (afade ran before asetpts), so the loop wrapped into a fade-up from near silence every P seconds. Repaired in place: the arc around the wrap is replaced by a spectrum-matched stretch of this file with equal-power crossfades; sample count unchanged. DECISIONS.md, 'The wrap was a hole'.
